WITH patient_admissions AS (

    a.subject_id,
    a.hadm_id,
    a.admittime,
    a.dischtime,
    a.hospital_expire_flag,
    DATETIME_DIFF(a.admittime, DATETIME(p.anchor_year, 1, 1), DAY) / 365.25 + p.anchor_age AS age_at_admission
  FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
